Task 6  
 
Task  Title : 
 Build a Context -Aware Chat Assistant with Memory  
Task Description :  
In this task, you will build a simple AI chat assistant that can remember information 
from previous messages and use it in future responses.  
The goal is to understand how memory and context handling work in real Generative 
AI systems.  
You will load a language model and create a conversation system that stores the 
conversation history and sends it back to the model as context for each new question.  
This will a llow the AI to maintain a conversation instead of responding to each 
message independently.  
Task Objectives:  
 Load an LLM using a Python library (such as Hugging Face Transformers)  
 Build a chat loop where the user can ask multiple questions  
 Store conversati on history  
 Inject the previous conversation as context in each new prompt  
 Observe how memory affects the model's responses
